messages:
Ava (Design): Quick request 1 - we need a compact benchmark asset pack for the Apr webinar (Thu 11am). Deliverables: square social (1080x1080), hero banner (1200x628), one-slide quick explainer (16:9). Keep to brand colors, ensure alt text notes. Figma starter file: https://figma.com/file/xyz123
Miguel (Mktg Ops): Timeline?
Ava (Design): EOD Wed preferred so Growth can prep copy tests.
Rohit (PMM): Use the latest internal microbench numbers (drop-in):
Rohit (PMM): ```
Redwood Dedicated: p50=120ms, p95=210ms, cost=$0.25/1k tokens
Managed Endpoint: p50=320ms, p95=620ms, cost=$0.60/1k tokens
```
Ava (Design): Good. Need 2 headline variants + 1 subhead + CTA options. Also call out the single comparison row vs generic managed endpoint.
Priya (Growth): CTA options: "Try the demo", "See latency & cost", "Compare performance". Add UTM params: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=apr_launch&utm_medium=social
Miguel (Mktg Ops): Add campaign tags for inbound routing: campaign=apr_webinar_launch, lead_source=social. Sam: can you embed a hidden slug in exported filenames for analytics?
Sam (Designer): Yes 1 - will include slug and a metadata.json in the export zip.
Elena (Creative Ops): Accessibility checklist: WCAG contrast >=4.5:1 for text, alt text for images, mark strings for i18n (EN/DE/FR). Flag illustrations for legal review when in doubt.
Ava (Design): I'll deliver EN variants and mark copy for localization. Will run contrast checks and annotate in Figma.
Miguel (Mktg Ops): Also need story format (9:16) and an animated micro-GIF/MP4 (3 frames max). Keep motion subtle.
Sam (Designer): I can do a micro-sparkline reveal for the benchmark numbers + a fast CTA fade. Export both GIF and MP4.
Priya (Growth): For messaging tests: provide 3 headline options and 2 tone targets (technical vs benefits-led). We'll A/B across socials.
Rohit (PMM): I'll post 2 benefit-led lines and 1 technical stat-led headline by EOD.
Ava (Design): Legal/brand check 1 - any issues with the new sparkline treatment?
Miguel (Mktg Ops): Tagging @design-bot for automated brand/export checks.
design-bot: Automated check queued. Ruleset: approved palette, logo clearspace, correct typeface usage, filename conventions. Status: pending final frames.
Elena (Creative Ops): After export, upload to marketing drive path: /webinar/apr_launch/bench_assets and tag as rc1. Include metadata file with campaign tags and alt text.
Ava (Design): Plan: post v1 frames by noon Wed for copy testing; final export by EOD Wed.
Sam (Designer): Starting designs now 1 - will drop first frames here when ready.
Miguel (Mktg Ops): Reminder: add canonical citation line on assets: "Data: internal Redwood inference benchmarks (Mar 2026)" and include tracking slug.
Rohit (PMM): Adding citation to the slide copy now.
Ava (Design): Great. If anything blocks, ping me in-thread. :thumbsup:
Sam (Designer): Uploaded initial frames to Figma. Will post export link shortly.
design-bot: File placeholder created: /exports/2166123456_bench_rc1.zip (content pending).
Miguel (Mktg Ops): Thanks everyone 1 - appreciate the fast turnaround :rocket:
Ava (Design): Thanks team, appreciate the help."
